blockedAssertions.blockedBy: Requires Tailscale tsnet with TS_AUTHKEY for auto-TLS via ListenTLS. Cannot test HTTPS with auto-TLS without a real Tailscale tailnet connection.
Requires Tailscale tsnet with TS_AUTHKEY for MagicDNS hostname resolution. Cannot test MagicDNS without a real Tailscale tailnet connection.
